stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, plus first steps in computational thinking and Python, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading and writing, life, physical and earth science, history, and programming in Python.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra, geometry, trigonometry, precalculus, calculus and statistics, the sciences, English and history, and Python for data and simulation.

stages.name: College mathematics degree
stages.blurb: Calculus, linear algebra, proof and discrete mathematics; real and complex analysis, abstract algebra and topology; probability, number theory, combinatorics, numerical analysis and differential equations; geometry, dynamics, logic and computation as electives; and problem solving and mathematical writing.

stages.name: Graduate study and qualifying exams in mathematics
stages.blurb: Measure theory, graduate algebra, algebraic topology, smooth manifolds, functional analysis and probability theory, with qualifying-exam preparation and a first expository paper.
